title: kb-verify lint.py given a kb/-prefixed article path lints nothing and prints errors=0 warnings=0, so a worker reports a clean lint the land then refuses
goal: lint.py (kb-verify) given an article path with the kb directory prefix lints that article as it does the root-relative path (public/<path>.md); an argument that matches no file of any root makes lint.py exit non-zero naming it instead of printing errors=0 warnings=0

run: import subprocess,sys;L='.claude/skills/kb-verify/lint.py';run=lambda *a:[l for l in subprocess.run([sys.executable,L,'--candidates',*a],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout.splitlines() if l.startswith('CODE-CANDIDATE')];p=run()[0].split()[1].rsplit(':',1)[0];a=run(p);b=run('kb/'+p);print(len(a),len(b));sys.exit(0 if a and a==b else 1)

clauses.clause: lint.py (kb-verify) given an article path with the kb directory prefix lints that article as it does the root-relative path (public/<path>.md)
an argument that matches no file of any root makes lint.py exit non-zero naming it instead of printing errors=0 warnings=0

notes: Planned at the 2026-10-12 draft triage (sprint 3 of 19, "Checks that passed broken work: ledger citations, lint paths, the held-out reword gate and the query-log apply guards"): it serves the fitness tests of EP-gzr4mmkm: a lookup's verdict or the benchmark's measurement is wrong until it is fixed. Premise: lint.py kb/public/no-such-dir/no-such-article.md exits 0 and prints errors=0 warnings=0 (the repro exits 1 on the base, run at planning 2026-10-12). lint.wanted() matches a bare or root-qualified path only, so a kb/ prefix selects nothing. Callers that pass paths (bl_land.changed_articles passes every changed .md of a root, ledgers too) stay clean: only an argument naming no file is refused. Found at the SP-up5wchen retrospective: the research worker reported lint errors=0 on its ten articles given with the kb/ prefix and the land's lint refused a CODE tag without a path#symbol pointer in one of them. The first check runs lint.py --candidates, which reads the same argument list as the lint, on a live candidate with and without the kb/ prefix (the live kb lints clean, so no lint finding is plantable on it); the worker also asserts a kb/-prefixed path in the lint test it extends (no new test id).

run: import subprocess,sys;L='.claude/skills/kb-verify/lint.py';run=lambda *a:[l for l in subprocess.run([sys.executable,L,'--candidates',*a],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout.splitlines() if l.startswith('CODE-CANDIDATE')];p=run()[0].split()[1].rsplit(':',1)[0];a=run(p);b=run('kb/'+p);print(len(a),len(b));sys.exit(0 if a and a==b else 1)
